albumInformation:
Feel free to use Love is Dying ft. Fliss for personal use or any for project you like - all it needs is crediting as 'Love is Dying Ft. Fliss' written & composed by Nick Myer for AGENDA 23'

Additional voice credits:

Female vocoda voice + rap: C

Female chorus voice: Fliss

It's not the world's most expensive recording but hopefully it's captured something including emotion -something most can relate to especially where love's concerned.

Expect things to get better production-wise over time. Check out the first AGENDA 23 release on itunes..which includes my voice singing which won't happen often for AGENDA 23 songs(Phew). It would really help for this project's progress & future if you got yourself a copy of the song at the itunes link "WAKE UP NOW".. It's UK chart registered..so if enough people downloaded it, who knows.. :) Enjoy anyway..and thanks for your support..and look out for future releases..in the very near future too. There will be many..and much and varying material is already composed.
